# Operations and Setup Requirements Quality Checklist: Contact Form and Message Retrieval

**Purpose**: Validate the requirements for the setup walkthrough, the setup check, cost ceiling, free-plan capacity and parallel-merge handling
**Created**: 2026-09-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md), [contracts/setup-items.md](../contracts/setup-items.md), [contracts/worker-config.md](../contracts/worker-config.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Items test the quality of the written requirements, not the implementation.

## Walkthrough Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is "every step only Don can do" enumerated so completeness can be judged against a closed list? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the required format of each step (what, where, how to confirm) defined precisely enough to review? [Clarity, Spec §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK003 Are step ordering and dependencies (stores before secrets, before-merge versus after-merge) specified? [Gap, Spec US9]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the region restatement requirements consistent between FR-027a, the clarification and the assumptions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-027a, Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK005 Is it defined what the walkthrough does if Don wants a different region, given it cannot be changed after creation? [Gap, Spec §FR-027a]
- [ ] CHK006 Are recovery instructions defined for a step that fails or is partly done (for example one database created, one not)? [Gap, Spec US9]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the token or permission scope needed by the walkthrough and the setup check stated and consistent with Principle VII? [Consistency, Spec §FR-027, §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "without help" in SC-010 defined by a measurable criterion or stated verification method? [Measurability, Spec SC-010]

## Setup Check Coverage

- [ ] CHK009 Does each condition in FR-028 map to exactly one setup item, with none of the plan's seven items left without a requirement? [Traceability, Spec §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "structure is up to date" defined (which migrations, how currency is judged)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK011 Are both environments covered for every condition, including the Turnstile widget's allowed domains? [Completeness, Spec §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK012 Are pass and fail outputs specified for partial completion, including that every missing item is named? [Clarity, Spec US9 scenarios 1-2]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the distinction between items required before merge and after merge stated in the spec, not only the plan? [Gap, Spec §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK014 Is behaviour defined when the setup check cannot reach Cloudflare (offline, expired token), so it is not read as pass or as missing? [Gap, Spec §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the name-only secret check reconciled with detecting a wrong or empty value, or is the limitation acknowledged? [Assumption, Spec US9 scenario 3]

## Cost Ceiling and Free-Plan Capacity

- [ ] CHK016 Are the relevant free-plan limits (Worker requests, CPU time, D1 rows and storage, cron triggers, Turnstile) each named with a threshold? [Completeness, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK017 Is "expected usage" quantified with an assumed volume, including an abuse scenario? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK018 Is behaviour defined when a free-plan limit is reached (visitor experience, and how Don finds out)? [Gap, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the $0 claim in SC-008 consistent with a second Worker, log retention and build minutes, and are those included in the estimate? [Consistency, Spec SC-008]
- [ ] CHK020 Is monitoring for approaching quota or cost limits addressed or explicitly excluded? [Gap, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the indexed-query requirement stated in the spec with a measurable criterion, matching Principle VIII? [Traceability, Spec §FR-025]

## Notifications and Observability

- [ ] CHK022 Is the absence of notifications reconciled with how Don learns that the assistant, the clean-up or the form has stopped working? [Gap, Spec §FR-026]
- [ ] CHK023 Is what may be logged for diagnosis defined positively (allowed fields), not only prohibited by FR-016? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016]

## Delivery and Merge Handling

- [ ] CHK024 Are the preview checks Don must perform before approving this major change listed? [Gap, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK025 Are rebase and conflict-resolution requirements for shared files stated so parallel features cannot silently overwrite each other? [Coverage, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK026 Is a rollback path defined if production deployment or a migration fails after merge? [Gap, Spec US9]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the performance budget quantified in the spec or clearly referenced to its source? [Measurability, Spec §FR-009, SC-009]
- [ ] CHK028 Is "typical connection" defined for SC-001? [Ambiguity, Spec SC-001]
